This role offers the opportunity to work with a diverse and talented group of individuals committed to driving success. The ideal candidate will design, deploy, and sustain enterprise storage and network-attached storage solutions in classified and unclassified environments. This role provides Tier 3 engineering support for storage systems, ensuring high availability, data integrity, performance, and recoverability across enterprise and wide area network environments. The Storage Engineer is responsible for storage architecture, capacity planning, replication strategies, patching, troubleshooting, and data recovery while supporting modernization efforts and project integration in compliance with DoD and Intelligence Community standards. Key Responsibilities The Storage Engineer will Design, deploy, configure, and maintain enterprise storage and network storage appliances Provide Tier 3 support for storage systems and storage-related incidents Install system patches and perform storage platform updates Engineer and manage storage allocation, capacity planning, space utilization, and replication strategies Analyze and resolve complex issues related to storage systems and network storage solutions Troubleshoot and restore enterprise-wide storage and replication failures across wide area networks Perform data recovery operations to ensure system continuity and mission availability Monitor storage performance, availability, and utilization to prevent outages Provide technical recommendations for storage upgrades, enhancements, and life cycle improvements Support project integration efforts, migrations, and modernization initiatives Develop and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and recovery plans Ensure compliance with DoD cybersecurity, data protection, and operational requirements Skills And Experience The Storage Engineer must have Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance 8+ years of experience supporting enterprise storage environments within the Department of Defense (DoD) or Intelligence Community (IC) Strong hands-on experience with Network-Attached Storage (NAS) and Storage Area Networks (SAN) and Data replication, backup, and disaster recovery solutions Experience troubleshooting complex storage, replication, and performance issues across Wide Area Network (WAN) environments Familiarity with Patch management and system updates, High-availability and fault-tolerant storage architectures, and Disaster recovery (DR) and Continuity of Operations (COOP) planning Experience analyzing storage performance issues and implementing optimization solutions Experience providing Tier 3 engineering support and mentoring junior technical staff Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or Intelligence Community storage environments Experience working in high-availability, mission-critical environments Ability to support after-hours, on-call, or emergency operations as required Education and Certifications The Storage Engineer must meet the following Required Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline Equivalent experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree Preferred NetApp Certified Data Administrator (NCDA - ONTAP) or equivalent storage certification CompTIA Security+ CE Vendor-specific storage or virtualization certifications (Dell EMC, VMware, etc.) Benefits Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance Flexible Spending Accounts 401(k) PTO Paid Parental Leave Tuition reimbursement Paid federal holidays Security Clearance Must be a U.S. Citizen. A high-level Department of Defense active security clearance is/may be required. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to government information. Physical Requirements Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time and typing and reading from a computer screen. The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary. Company Summary Headquartered in Hawaii, Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC, is an SBA-Certified NHO-owned 8(a) Small Business specializing in global information technology solutions. We deliver professional services in IT Design & Installation, Cybersecurity Engineering & Support, Application Integration & Development, Software & Hardware Engineering, Network & Systems Management, Information Systems Security, and Business Management Services. Leveraging over 30 years of providing IT services to the federal & commercial market with projects found around the world, our team has innovative expertise in the development of a wide range of technological solutions. Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Our service commitment is simple - "Quality IT Solutions... On Time & On Budget." Company Employment Statement Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing as positions, functions, and qualifications may vary depending on business needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, color, creed, religion, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition), sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, or Vietnam era, or other eligible veteran status or legally protected characteristics. Buena organización y gestión de prioridades. Si buscas un proyecto sólido donde seguir desarrollando tu carrera en Networking y Seguridad , trabajando con tecnologías como Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto o Aruba , nos encantará conocerte. Inscríbete y únete a SIRT para contribuir a la evolución y protección de infraestructuras críticas de comunicaciones.

review_candidates.description: Dexian Government Solutions. is recruiting for a DevOps Engineer to support our contract at the USAMRIID in Fort Detrick, MD. Target Salary : $110,000.00 to $120,000.00 Position Overview: LinTech Global is seeking a DevOps Engineer to implement, administer, and continuously improve the CI/CD pipeline supporting USAMRIID's applications development team using Azure DevOps Server. This role owns the full lifecycle of pipeline design, build/release automation, and integration with the team's SDLC delivery framework. The candidate will work closely with the Government Lead and development teams to ensure reliable, secure, and auditable software delivery in a DoD on-prem environment. Job Duties: Recommend, resource, and establish CI/CD pipeline capability - assess current build/release processes, recommend tooling and pipeline architecture, and lead implementation from the ground up Design, build, and maintain YAML and/or classic CI/CD pipelines for multiple applications/teams Manage self-hosted build/release agents and agent pools, including capacity planning and troubleshooting Implement branching strategies, build validation policies, and release gates Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot build failures and optimize pipeline performance Support deployment and sprint management, including release scheduling, sprint ceremonies coordination, and alignment of deployment cadence with the program's Gated Agile framework Support ADO Kanban board configuration and reporting for sprint teams Install, configure, and maintain Azure DevOps Server (project collections, application tier, and SQL Server data tier) Administer IIS and Windows Server infrastructure supporting Azure DevOps Server, including application tier configuration, patching, and performance tuning Build and maintain container images and pipelines, integrating containerized builds/deployments into the CI/CD workflow where applicable Administer Azure Artifacts (or equivalent) for package/dependency management Integrate Azure DevOps Server with on-prem Active Directory for authentication and RBAC Maintain STIG compliance and security hardening for the Azure DevOps Server environment Develop and maintain SOPs/runbooks for pipeline operations, server recovery, and agent management Support change control processes in coordination with the Government Lead Required Qualifications Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar) - including standing up a pipeline from scratch, with tooling recommendations and resourcing Experience with Git-based source control and branching strategies (trunk-based, GitFlow, or similar) Strong PowerShell and/or Bash scripting skills Experience supporting SDLC, deployment, and sprint management in hybrid Agile-Waterfall delivery environment Requirements to Start: Active DOD Secret Clearance is Required to Start An IAT Level II Certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE) is Required to Start Dexian Government Solutions is an award-winning, ISO 9001:2015 certified, business and GSA contract holder providing diversified Information Technology services to both Civilian and Defense agencies. Our combination of technical expertise, big business experience, and small business agility allows us to promptly provide our customers with exceptional IT and engineering solutions.
